question.en: How large is the image-recording area?
question.zh-cn: 实际记录图像的区域有多大？

summary.en: Use physical image width and height, with the specific format or equipment stated.
summary.zh-cn: 比较实际成像宽高，并注明具体格式或设备。

boundary.en: Full frame refers to the familiar 36 × 24 mm reference, not a maximum size. Film stock names, sheet sizes and exposed image areas are different measurements.
boundary.zh-cn: 全画幅指常见的 36 × 24 mm 参考规格，不表示最大画幅。胶卷名称、片材尺寸和实际曝光区域是不同信息。

en: APS-C is a family of dimensions; read the actual camera specification. The X-T5 uses 23.5 × 15.7 mm, while the GFX100RF uses 43.8 × 32.9 mm. The comparison tool uses stated representative image areas on one scale. Its diagonal crop factor does not change lens focal length or match both axes when aspect ratios differ.
zh-cn: APS-C 包含多种尺寸，应查具体相机规格。X-T5 使用 23.5 × 15.7 mm，GFX100RF 使用 43.8 × 32.9 mm。比较工具将注明来源的代表性成像区域放在同一比例尺下，对角线画幅系数不会改变镜头焦距，宽高比不同时也不保证两个方向视角同时相同。
